models.name: zuora__billing_history
models.description: Each record is an invoice to evaluate the history of charges billed, enhanced with additional details from payments, refunds, adjustments, discounts, and taxes.

columns.name: invoice_id
columns.description: The unique identifier of the invoice table.

columns.name: account_id
columns.description: The account associated with the invoice.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: The time at which the invoice was created.

columns.name: invoice_number
columns.description: The unique identification number for the invoice.

columns.name: invoice_date
columns.description: Specifies the date on which to generate the invoice.

columns.name: invoice_amount
columns.description: The sum of all charges and taxes associated with the invoice.

columns.name: invoice_amount_home_currency
columns.description: The sum of all charges and taxes associated with the invoice in its home currency.

columns.name: invoice_amount_paid
columns.description: The amount of the invoice currently paid for.

columns.name: invoice_amount_unpaid
columns.description: The amount of the invoice yet to be paid for.

columns.name: tax_amount
columns.description: The total amount of the taxes applied to the invoice.

columns.name: refund_amount
columns.description: The amount of refunds applied to the invoice.

columns.name: credit_balance_adjustment_amount
columns.description: The amount of the credit balance adjustment applied to the invoice.

columns.name: transaction_currency
columns.description: Transaction currency the customer is billed in.

columns.name: home_currency
columns.description: Home currency the customer is billed in.

columns.name: exchange_rate_date
columns.description: The date of the exchange rate used for the invoice.

columns.name: due_date
columns.description: The due date of the invoice.

columns.name: status
columns.description: The status of the invoice in the system. This status is not the status of the payment of the invoice just the status of the invoice itself.

columns.name: purchase_type
columns.description: The type of the invoice source.

columns.name: invoice_items
columns.description: The number of invoice item in the invoice.

columns.name: products
columns.description: The number of products billed in the invoice.

columns.name: subscriptions
columns.description: The number of subscriptions in the invoice.

columns.name: total_quantity
columns.description: The total quantity across all invoice items in the invoice.

columns.name: first_charge_date
columns.description: The first charge date for the invoice.

columns.name: most_recent_charge_date
columns.description: The most recent charge date for the invoice.

columns.name: invoice_service_start_date
columns.description: Earliest invoice item service start date for the invoice.

columns.name: invoice_service_end_date
columns.description: Earliest invoice item service end date for the invoice.

columns.name: payments
columns.description: The number of payments applied to the invoice.

columns.name: payment_methods
columns.description: The number of payment methods associated with the invoice.

columns.name: credit_balance_adjustments
columns.description: The number of the credit balance adjustments applied on the invoice.

columns.name: first_credit_balance_adjustment_date
columns.description: The first date when a credit balance adjustment is applied to the invoice.

columns.name: most_recent_credit_balance_adjustment_date
columns.description: The most recent date when a credit balance adjustment is applied to the invoice.
